$comment: D-1 delivery and customer-acknowledgment spec companion, 2026-10-20. Firebase-parity holders derived READ-ONLY from functions/src/access/{permissionCatalog,compatibilityRoles,governedBusinessRoles}.ts at main b3d09dc3 (scratch copy; nothing written to a role, a grant, a database or a fixture). No migration is proposed by this file. The parity set for any NEW delivery or acknowledgment key is empty.
decision: Brief 2026-10-20: derive Firebase-parity holders A7-style. Grants not in exact Firebase parity are a STOP. None is authorized by this file.

baseline.eosSource: NOT READ. EOS holders are Administration data in eos_policy.role_capabilities; the brief forbids touching an environment, and the repository seed baseline is not the live table.

newKeySearch.pattern: permission id containing deliver, signat, acknowledg or proof
newKeySearch.note: permissionCatalog.ts:1365 states CUSTOMER delivery is a separate, not-yet-authorized future capability and is not registered. Firebase never held a delivery, signature, acknowledgment or proof-of-delivery key.

workOrder.create.use: create a DELIVERY (or INSTALL) Work Order from Sales Order lines

workOrder.labor.record.use: precedent only: EOS labor reuses workOrder.execution.record

salesOrder.service.use: only once S1c registers it in EOS (S1a companion); not required by D-1 because workOrder.create already accepts salesOrderId and salesOrderLines

workOrder.execution.record.use: EOS-native; the assigned Employee records the delivery record and the acknowledgment (RECORD_ASSIGNMENT). Reusing it widens its stated meaning (Owner Decision 15).

excluded.reason: Not Firebase holders: Firebase had no such keys, so every holder would be a non-parity grant. STOP until the Owner names holders (Owner Decisions 13, 14, 15).

notes: A null firebaseHolders means the key is EOS-native and has no Firebase counterpart; a null eosHolders means not read.
workOrder.transition and workOrder.create list Firebase holders only; the live EOS grants for the EOS-native lifecycle keys are Administration decisions and are not asserted here.
If the Owner takes Owner Decision 15 A, no capability is registered and no role_capabilities row is added. If 15 B, a separate parity-exempt ruling on holders is required before any migration.
